name: Chitral
summary: **Chitral** is a [[kind:landrace|landrace]] [[label:indica|indica]] from the Chitral district of [[country:PK|Pakistan]], in the Hindu Kush foothills of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Seed has been preserved and distributed by collectors such as the Landrace Team. It flowers indoors in 8 to 9 weeks and outdoors in late September to early October in the Northern Hemisphere.
